biotools.summary: An interactive web portal and suite of R packages (HPOExplorer, KGExplorer, MSTExplorer) designed to characterize cell type-specific mechanisms underlying rare diseases by integrating the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) with single-cell transcriptomics.
